skip_reason: The travel-cog skill is a thin client wrapper around CellCog's proprietary cloud AI service. All core operations require `client.create_chat(...)` calls to an authenticated external API endpoint. There is no offline execution path, no local model, and no way to mock the service without the real CellCog credentials/API keys. This violates the 'Authenticated/Stateful Network' ban — the skill cannot function in an isolated Docker container without real API keys to CellCog's backend.
